title: A capture's deadline-bounded lock wait rounds down to whole milliseconds and can report a busy error just before the deadline
outcome: A capture's deadline-bounded lock wait rounds down to whole milliseconds and can report a busy error just before the deadline
acceptance: A lock wait the capture deadline cut short is rounded up to whole milliseconds (at least 1 ms), or a busy error from such a wait is reported as backup_capture_deadline; a test in the repository covers the chosen rule

completion.summary: Capture lock waits now round positive fractional milliseconds up after the five-second cap; elapsed waits remain zero and absent deadlines five seconds. Added deterministic boundary and SQLite busy_timeout roundtrip coverage. Full gate, clean independent pair and fresh independent acceptance passed. Committed, installed and pushed under Fable window; four live stores ready.
